source: Exact retained projector N and coordinate metric from the common three-carrier coefficient assembler
configuration_space: Unit sphere of im(N) in its source metric, treated as a real Riemannian manifold
kinetic_readout: Normalized real overlap Hessian, following the prior comparison-kinetic-readout construction
quantization: Scalar Laplace-Beltrami operator on the complete unit sphere; no curvature potential
internal_occupation: Common U(1) phase momentum k=+1 in each occupied sector; conserved by the sphere action
common_vacuum: Separate empty state with zero energy and zero internal/external charge
forbidden_repairs: no replacement by only the phase circle when transverse carrier directions exist
scope: A prospective occupied-sector action using existing source metric; quantization and k=1 sector admission are declared rules, not results of projector algebra
